final_message:
I fixed the lint error: in the `imports` cell of `notebooks/explore.py`, `import marimo as mo` now comes before `import polars as pl`, so the imports are in alphabetical order. Nothing else changed. Ruff isn't installed in the venv, so I checked with `uvx ruff check`, which reports "All checks passed!"

I edited the file on disk rather than through the live marimo-pair session. The session may need to reload the file, or it could write the old order back when it next saves.
